newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam Assembly approves cabinet reshuffle.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam Assembly approves cabinet reshuffle.

text.p: Vietnam's National Assembly has approved plans for a sweeping cabinet reshuffle but has rejected several proposed nominees, state television said on Wednesday.
The assembly approved changes to 12 ministerial or ministerial-level posts, but consented to only eight newcomers and the reassignment of one minister to a new cabinet portfolio.
The proposed changes were put to the assembly earlier in the day by Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet. The reasons for the rejection was not immediately clear.

Vietnam Television said those approved for new cabinet positions were Tran Xuan Gia as Minister for Planning and Investment, Le Minh Huong as head of the powerful Interior (Police) Ministry and Nguyen Sinh Hung as Finance Minister.

Pham Gia Khiem was accepted as minister for Science, Technology and the Environment, Nguyen Khoa Diem as Culture and Information Minister, Ta Quang Ngoc as Marine Products Minister and Lai Van Cu as Minister for the Government Office.

The ministerial-level position of head of the Organisation and Personnel Committee of the Government goes to Do Quang Trung. Barring a break from previous practise, the new posts will be formally announced at the close of the assembly session in a week's time.
